title: Ward 2009: fascicle length optimal of multifidus at whole (mixed, cadaver)

imaging.posture_detail: cadaver fixed in supine neutral lumbar posture

quantity.name: fascicle_length_optimal
quantity.definition: fibre length normalised to optimal sarcomere length (state value used)

source.authors: Ward SR, Kim CW, Eng CM, Gottschalk LJ, Tomiya A, Garfin SR, Lieber RL
source.sample: 8 cadaveric lumbar spines; formalin-fixed cadavers (T12-sacrum, fixed supine/neutral), age 84 (3) y, height 170.5 (11.1) cm, weight 81.1 (15.3) kg; plus 16 surgical patients for intraoperative biopsies

how_to_simulate: Take the model multifidus element(s) named in the data (optimal fibre length / tendon slack length / MTU length in neutral posture).
Compare raw fascicle length with model fibre length in the specimen posture, and sarcomere-normalised length with model optimal fibre length.
protocol.notes: Abstract/results give mean +/- standard ERROR (stored in "se"; sd left empty).

data.note: normalised to 2.7 um optimal sarcomere length

extraction.check_notes: Abstract values re-read. Per-level values (Fig. 4) not digitised.
